description:
Create/upsert the site's DNS in Cloudflare - the A record + the DNS-AID
    SVCB/HTTPS records - and (optionally) turn on DNSSEC. PREFERRED credential path:
    save the token to a file on your machine (chmod 600) and pass token_file=<path> -
    the path is safe in chat, the secret is not. (Also: ZX_CF_TOKEN_FILE=<path> env, or
    ZX_CF_TOKEN=<value>.) Passing token=… inline works but writes it to the transcript.
    dry_run shows the exact records; confirm executes. The token is NEVER echoed back.
name: cloudflare_apply
